title: Real-time Order Integration via OData API
challengeDescription: Customer needed real-time order synchronization between e-commerce platform and S/4HANA with <5 second latency
solutionDescription: Implemented OData API with Enterprise Event Enablement for order creation notifications
technologiesUsed: ["OData v4 API","Enterprise Events","SAP Event Mesh","SAP BTP Integration Suite"]
implementation: Used released S/4HANA Sales Order API (A_SalesOrder) with standard fields. Subscribed to BusinessPartner.Created events for real-time notifications
lessonsLearned: Start with API discovery early. Event subscriptions require proper filtering to avoid performance issues
keywords: real-time integration odata api e-commerce orders event-driven

title: Side-by-side Pricing Extension on BTP
challengeDescription: Complex customer-specific pricing rules that cannot be configured in standard pricing conditions
solutionDescription: Built custom pricing microservice on BTP using CAP, exposed as OData service, called from S/4HANA using BTP Destination
implementation: Pricing service deployed on BTP reads pricing rules from HANA Cloud schema. S/4HANA calls service via HTTP during sales order simulation using BADI
lessonsLearned: Multi-tenancy adds complexity but enables SaaS model. Caching pricing rules reduces DB load by 70%
keywords: custom pricing btp extension side-by-side microservice

title: Embedded Analytics Dashboard
challengeDescription: Executive leadership needed real-time KPI dashboard for patient admission metrics
solutionDescription: Used SAP Analytics Cloud embedded in S/4HANA with standard CDS views
technologiesUsed: ["SAP Analytics Cloud","CDS Views","HANA Live Models","Embedded Analytics"]
implementation: Leveraged standard healthcare industry CDS views (I_PatientAdmission, I_BedOccupancy). Built SAC story with drill-down capabilities
lessonsLearned: Standard CDS views cover 80% of requirements. Custom extensions used wrapper views without modifying base objects

title: Batch Purchase Order Integration
challengeDescription: Supplier portal needed daily batch transfer of purchase orders to supplier systems
solutionDescription: Implemented Enhanced IDOC with delta processing for changed POs only
implementation: Configured PORDCR Enhanced IDOC with delta logic. BTP Integration Suite performs XML transformation for supplier format
lessonsLearned: Delta processing reduces volume by 80%. Error handling with retry logic essential for reliability

title: SAP S/4HANA Material Master Migration
challengeDescription: Migrating 2 million materials from legacy ERP to S/4HANA with complex classifications
solutionDescription: Used Migration Cockpit with parallel processing and staging tables
implementation: Split materials into 10 work packages. Implemented pre-validation in staging tables. Parallel execution with 8 threads
lessonsLearned: Staging tables critical for validation. Parallel processing reduces time by 75%. Test with production-like volumes

title: SOX Compliance Reports
challengeDescription: Complex financial reports for SOX compliance with specific layouts and audit trails
solutionDescription: Used Smart Forms with custom CDS views for data extraction
implementation: Created wrapper CDS views over standard financial tables. Smart Forms templates with required regulatory format
lessonsLearned: Audit requirements demand complete traceability. Archive old data to maintain performance

title: Customer Invoice Interactive PDFs
challengeDescription: Utility company needed fillable PDF invoices for customer payments
solutionDescription: Implemented Adobe Forms with QR code integration for payment processing
implementation: Adobe LiveCycle Designer for form layout. Integrated QR code for mobile payment. PDF generated on-demand
lessonsLearned: Adobe Forms licensing costs significant. QR codes improve payment adoption by 40%

title: Multi-Step PR Approval Workflow
challengeDescription: Complex approval matrix based on amount, department, and cost center
solutionDescription: Used BTP Workflow Management with flexible decision tables
technologiesUsed: ["BTP Workflow Management","Decision Tables","SAP Fiori My Inbox"]
implementation: Workflow deployed on BTP. Decision tables define approval routing. Fiori My Inbox for mobile approvals
lessonsLearned: Decision tables easier to maintain than hard-coded rules. Mobile approval adoption 85%

title: Custom Fields for Batch Tracking
challengeDescription: FDA-regulated batch tracking required additional fields on material master
solutionDescription: Used Key User Extensibility to add custom fields with validation
implementation: Added 5 custom fields via KUE. Extended CDS views for reporting. UI adapted in Fiori apps
lessonsLearned: Key User Extensibility perfect for simple field additions. No custom code maintenance required

title: Large File Data Import
challengeDescription: Daily import of 200MB CSV files from legacy metering systems
solutionDescription: Implemented file-based integration with BTP Integration Suite and staging tables
implementation: BTP polls SFTP for files. Data loaded to staging tables. Background job validates and posts to S/4HANA
lessonsLearned: File splitting improves reliability. Staging approach enables restart capability after errors

title: Real-time Sales Analytics
challengeDescription: Sales teams needed mobile-friendly dashboard with drill-down by region/product
solutionDescription: Used SAP Analytics Cloud with live connection to S/4HANA
implementation: SAC story with standard CDS views. Mobile app for field sales. Drilldown from global to store level
lessonsLearned: Live connection performs better than data replication. Mobile adoption drives data-driven decisions

title: Multi-Source Customer Data Migration
challengeDescription: Consolidating customer data from 5 legacy CRM systems with deduplication
solutionDescription: Custom ABAP programs with fuzzy matching for duplicate detection
implementation: Fuzzy matching on name/address identifies duplicates. Manual review workflow for conflicts. MDG governance
lessonsLearned: Invest in data quality upfront. Manual review essential for high-value customers

title: Parallel Quality Approval Process
challengeDescription: Quality inspections require approval from 3 departments simultaneously
solutionDescription: Implemented parallel approval workflow with consensus rules
implementation: Workflow splits to 3 approvers. Waits for all responses. Escalation after 48 hours
lessonsLearned: Parallel processing reduces approval time by 60%. Escalation rules critical for SLA compliance

title: Patient Appointment Reminders
challengeDescription: Automated email reminders for patient appointments 24 hours in advance
solutionDescription: Used BTP Event Mesh with email integration service
implementation: Scheduled job identifies next-day appointments. Publishes events to Event Mesh. Email service sends reminders
lessonsLearned: Event-driven approach more scalable than batch. Template management simplifies content updates

title: Legacy ABAP Report Modernization
challengeDescription: 100 custom ABAP reports needed for cloud migration
solutionDescription: Analyzed and refactored reports - 60% to CDS views, 40% replaced with SAC
implementation: Categorized reports by complexity. Simple reports to CDS/Fiori. Complex analytics to SAC. Retired 20 obsolete reports
lessonsLearned: Report inventory analysis saves time. Many reports can be replaced with standard analytics

title: Real-time Machine Data Integration
challengeDescription: Factory IoT sensors sending machine status every 30 seconds
solutionDescription: Used Enterprise Events with SAP Event Mesh for real-time processing
implementation: IoT Gateway publishes to Event Mesh. S/4HANA subscribes for critical events. HANA streaming for analytics
lessonsLearned: Event filtering crucial to avoid overload. Streaming analytics for predictive maintenance use cases
